name: vs-search-overlay
description: PhpStorm-style centered search overlay for VS Code, powered by VS Code's own file, text, symbol and command search.

commands.title: Search: Open Search to the Side

enumDescriptions: PhpStorm-style floating overlay (webview) inside the editor area
Native VS Code QuickPick at the top of the window
vsSearch.ui.description: Which UI `Search: Open Search Overlay` uses.

enumDescriptions: Floating centered box over the editor area; closes as soon as you leave the tab
Full editor tab with the same search UI filling the tab; stays open like a normal editor
vsSearch.presentation.description: How the search UI is presented: a modal-looking overlay or a full page tab.

enumDescriptions: Fixed Darcula-like palette, closest to PhpStorm
Follow the current VS Code theme colors

vsSearch.maxResults.description: Maximum number of results per provider (files, text, symbols, actions).

vsSearch.title.description: Title used by the QuickPick mode and the native fallback.

enumDescriptions: Open VS Code's native Search Editor in the editor area
Use the left sidebar search view
vsSearch.target.description: Where `Search: Open Search to the Side` and Alt+Enter send the query.

vsSearch.reuseSearchEditor.description: Reuse an existing Search Editor tab instead of opening a new one.

vsSearch.showIncludesExcludes.description: Show the 'files to include / exclude' inputs in the Search Editor.

vsSearch.historyLimit.description: How many recent queries the QuickPick mode remembers.
